cli.reason: Preserves running work and task data during updates. Ordinary automatic updates use a strict idle-only shutdown request and defer to new work; older Services reject that optional request and require an explicit manual update. Existing user commands and responses remain compatible.

service.reason: Adds atomic Host idle-switch admission, Claude process evidence and bounded reply review, and contains Codex request failures. Cloud Wake/result protocols are unchanged. Old CLI shutdown requests remain supported; no accepted work is forcibly stopped and no compatibility floor is raised.

skills.reason: No managed Skills source changes; existing Skills remain compatible.
